## IdentityCollectionReferenceData interface

Data form of a deferred collection of explicitly identified objects.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IdentityCollectionReferenceData<Id = unknown, R extends string = string>
```

## Remarks

Every entry is a single identity reference to the collection's own resource. The collection itself has no container; each entry carries its own when its identity is scoped to one.
